decisions.title: ADMIN target is checked only for present inherited/direct capabilities, omitting its SET-accessible closure
configuration: Existing snapshot login S has INHERIT TRUE/SET TRUE membership in retrolume_data_snapshot, as saved in real F02 graphs.
One fresh NOLOGIN bridge B has app membership INHERIT FALSE/SET TRUE and no current scope/control/schema/database/owner privileges.
S is member of B with ADMIN TRUE/INHERIT FALSE/SET FALSE.
decisions.current_static_result: S is audited as snapshot. B is neither selected/effective nor audited independently. ADMIN target predicates see only B's empty actual rights and false management/owner flags, so this graph is accepted.
decisions.reachable_effect: S may grant B to retrolume_data_snapshot with SET TRUE. Its existing SET path then reaches B->app, allowing normal application DELETE. This uses already granted ADMIN, not new superuser/CREATEROLE authority.
decisions.minimum_correction: Evaluate bounded potential SET/INHERIT/ADMIN escalation from an ADMIN target for the subject's purpose, while preserving legal harmless memberships.
decisions.minimum_followup: One transactional composite ADMIN-to-SET counterexample on the permitted synthetic cluster, plus harmless baseline and exact rollback/new-connection confirmation; no program execution or full role-suite rerun.

decisions.title: Q cleanup pending is reflected only in POST, while GET/reopen uses database purge done
decisions.trigger: Normal memory revoke/purge commits DB body deletion, then exact Q prepared-file removal fails. POST reports cleanup_status_unconfirmed=true and purge_state_now=pending; the next GET command receipt rebuilds from DB head purge_state=done without the Q pending journal. Reopen view similarly uses DB purge_state and hides the existing retry control.
decisions.effect: The retained Q plaintext file remains logically closed but unremoved, while read/reopen presentation can claim cleanup done and suppress the ordinary retry. No current outbound/body disclosure is alleged.
valid_subfacts_retained: Real source pending->reopen retry deleted at root60.
Normal memory revoke/purge removes its Q copies at root58.
Q artifact/operator/reference/gateway denial and financial/hash retention hold for listed records.
decisions.minimum_correction: Unify read-only receipt/view projection of DB purge and dependency-matched Q cleanup state, including unknown, without changing committed DB purge facts; keep the existing explicit retry available.
decisions.minimum_followup: One synthetic memory exact-file failure followed by same-key GET/reopen, failure persistence and successful explicit retry; compare body hashes/007/fees and unrelated objects. Do not replay old memory races.
